law_name: Law No. 94-036 of 18 September 1995 on Literary and Artistic Property
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (art. 52: current calendar year and following 70 years; joint works from death of last survivor; anonymous/pseudonymous/posthumous works 70 years from 1 January after publication)
enforcement_body: Malagasy Copyright Office (Office Malgache du Droit d'Auteur, OMDA), created by Decree No. 98-434 of 16 June 1998
notes: Law 94-036 still cited as the legal basis in a 2025 OMDA royalties decree; no replacement law found (a Loi 2020-002 was not confirmed). Berne since 1966; WCT/WPPT in force 24 Feb 2015; WTO since 1995 (Commons).
